description: Suggest reusable queue slots derived from best-time insights for one or more platforms.

platforms.description: Optional platform list. If omitted, suggestions may be generated for all supported platforms.

slotsPerPlatform.description: How many suggested slots to return per platform.

team_id.description: Team ID to operate in team scope. Get available teams with list_teams. If omitted, uses personal scope.

timezone.description: Optional IANA timezone for the suggested local queue times.

name: suggest_queue_slots
title: Suggest Queue Slots
